title: How Logology's Dagobert Renouf turned marketing into participating and service work into a product
summary: Dagobert Renouf, co-founder of Logology, explains how he went from spamming "what are you building" threads to participating on Twitter, why organic beat paid for his bootstrapped startup, and how he automated a designer's service workflow into a product. He also covers staying motivated through hopeless stretches.

principles.text: Add a negative motivation: what you refuse to go back to keeps you building when no customers show up.
principles.quote: to have like a negative motivation so what i mean by that is like not just something i want to reach so like help the world with like amazing brands when they're just starting but also what i want to avoid

principles.text: Replace "marketing" with "participating": join communities, meet and engage people instead of promoting yourself.
principles.quote: so what really helped me was that was like switching from marketing to participating and it's also way more fun

principles.text: Real marketing is connecting and listening, promoting your product only when it's useful.
principles.quote: real marketing is about connecting with people listening to people uh and trying to obviously promote your product when it's useful you know but that's it

principles.text: When you're new and unknown, organic beats paid because people trust it; Dagobert's paid tests (Google ads, newsletters) gave no sales.
principles.quote: when you're new and nobody knows you organic is so cool because people trust it way more

principles.text: Build the product by automating what you already do for clients as a service, balancing personalization with automation.
principles.quote: we basically took like everything she does with clients like that she just described and like try to make it into an automated way

principles.text: Pick work you enjoy, because enjoyment is what keeps you going when a good idea starts to look bad.
principles.quote: if you don't enjoy it you're going to give up when it's like this exact time that you should actually okay i'm not sure but i enjoy it so i keep doing anyway
